name: Mahou Senshi - After the Final ~Kokugin no Maou~
original_name: 魔法戦士 After the Final ～黒銀の魔王～
source:
Kiel, the love child of chaos, has overthrown the forces of the silver-haired demon king, Metzer Heinkel. He began his invasion in order to take over the world. The Mahou Senshi (Magical Warriors) who are supposed to be the greatest obstacle Kiel's ambition were captured one after the other. In order to make them his properties, Kiel bound them with the chains of lust...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01000249.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
混沌的私生子基尔推翻了银发魔王梅兹尔·海因克尔的势力，并为将世界收入掌中而展开侵略。本应是他野心最大阻碍的魔法战士们接连被俘。为了将她们变成自己的所有物，基尔用欲望的锁链将她们束缚……
